overview: The Critical Minerals Mission – Startup Support is a component of the Ministry of Mines' Science and Technology Programme, specifically under the Promotion of Research and Innovation in Startups and MSMEs in Mining, Mineral Processing, Metallurgy and Recycling Sector (S&T-PRISM). It aims to provide seed support to deserving startups and individual innovators in the critical minerals value chain, including exploration, extraction, processing, and recycling. The scheme is implemented through the release of funds to startups, MSMEs, and individual innovators to ensure timely availability of financial support for innovation in the critical minerals sector.
objectives: Provide seed support to deserving startups in the critical minerals sector
Support innovation in mining, mineral processing, metallurgy, and recycling
Ensure timely availability of financial support for individual innovators
Promote research and development in critical minerals and energy critical elements
Strengthen domestic capacity in critical minerals supply chain
Encourage private sector participation in critical minerals exploration and processing
eligibility: Startups, MSMEs, and individual innovators engaged in mining, mineral processing, metallurgy, and recycling sector, particularly those working on critical minerals and energy critical elements, are eligible for support under the S&T-PRISM programme of the Ministry of Mines.
benefits: Financial support in the form of grants for research and development projects, prototype development, technology validation, and market linkage. Non-financial benefits include technical guidance, access to Ministry of Mines' scientific institutions, networking opportunities with industry and academia, and facilitation of collaborations for scaling innovations.
financial_support: Under the S&T-PRISM programme, funds are released to startups, MSMEs, and individual innovators to support research and innovation projects. The exact quantum and mechanism of financial support are determined based on project proposals and are subject to approval by the Ministry of Mines' expert committees.
application_process: 1. Submit project proposal under the S&T-PRISM programme of the Ministry of Mines. 2. Proposal is reviewed by expert committees for technical feasibility and innovation potential. 3. Shortlisted applicants are invited for presentation or interview. 4. Final selection is made based on evaluation criteria. 5. Approved projects receive grant sanction and fund release. 6. Progress is monitored through periodic reports and site visits.
required_documents: Project proposal detailing objectives, methodology, and expected outcomes
Any prior work or prototypes related to critical minerals
Undertaking of compliance with Ministry of Mines guidelines
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round as per announcements under S&T-PRISM.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Mines, Government of India
caveats: Funding is subject to availability of budget under the S&T-PRISM programme
Projects must align with national priorities in critical minerals and energy critical elements
Grantees must submit periodic progress reports and utilization certificates
Intellectual property generated may be subject to government-use rights
Support is limited to seed-stage and early validation phases
